name: Emergency Department
description: Provides immediate emergency medical assessment and urgent care for incoming patients.

name: Cardiology
description: Specializes in the diagnosis and treatment of heart and cardiovascular diseases.

name: General Surgery
description: Performs a wide range of surgical procedures and postoperative care.

name: Orthopedics
description: Treats musculoskeletal injuries, fractures, and bone-related conditions.

name: Neurology
description: Focuses on disorders of the brain, spinal cord, and nervous system.

name: Neurosurgery
description: Provides surgical treatment for neurological and spinal conditions.

name: Pediatrics
description: Delivers healthcare services for infants, children, and adolescents.

name: Oncology
description: Diagnoses and treats patients with cancer and related diseases.

name: Intensive Care Unit
description: Provides critical care and continuous monitoring for severely ill patients.

name: Radiology
description: Performs diagnostic imaging examinations including X-rays, CT, and MRI scans.

name: Pathology
description: Conducts laboratory analysis and pathological examinations for disease diagnosis.

name: Pulmonology
description: Treats respiratory system diseases and pulmonary disorders.

name: Gastroenterology
description: Specializes in digestive system disorders and gastrointestinal treatments.

name: Urology
description: Treats urinary tract disorders and male reproductive system conditions.

name: Obstetrics and Gynecology
description: Provides healthcare services related to pregnancy, childbirth, and gynecological care.
